status: locked training protocol; final abstraction and statistical preregistration pending before test scoring
item_vocabulary: training exposures only, descending frequency then item ID tie break; unknown item index 0
current_inputs: intrinsic-duration context under the recorded availability policy
checkpoint_selection: lowest equal-user validation NLL across three fixed epochs; earliest epoch wins ties
training_objective: mean binary cross entropy across fixed per-user-capped training cases
markov_baseline: last available rate token crossed with current tab, Beta(1,1) smoothing; no item context
test_scoring: prohibited in this training controller; role-separated training/validation artifacts only
provider_inference: none; GPT-6.1 and Claude API calls prohibited

resource_budget.scope: timeout reservation plus staging and startup allowance; not actual billing
resource_budget.hardware_policy: CPU float32, eight threads, same full models and case matrix; GPU availability is not a prerequisite

intrinsic_context.availability: known strictly prior upload day; duration is an intrinsic-property availability assumption
intrinsic_context.normalization: center/scale log duration using known training cases only; missing rows remain zero plus flag one
intrinsic_context.ablation: context-only predictor uses the same item/tab/duration inputs with no behavioral history

prediction_head: two-layer MLP with GELU, hidden width 128, allowing history/context interactions
